contran_945.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
Every lashed unit has lashings rated for at least twice its weight.
Each unit is secured with at least 4 lashing terminals.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
Nothing above the headboard can slide forward over it.

securing.message: Only straps, chains, blocking or mats secure the load.
Every lashed unit has lashings rated for at least twice its weight.
Each unit is secured with at least 4 lashing terminals.
Lashings are anchored to the truck's lashing points on the metal frame.
No room to travel along the truck, or diagonal devices hold the load.
